name: image-codec
summary: Dependency-free, bounded raster image code for constrained Ferrite apps: PNG, JPEG (baseline and progressive), GIF (first frame) and WebP (lossless and lossy) decoders that return `None` on hostile input instead of panicking, a PNG encoder, and model-input preparation that recognises an image and resizes and re-encodes it to a model's dimension and payload limits.
